svg.title: Multimodal architecture for Hong Kong visitor arrivals forecasting
svg.desc: A frozen arrivals model queries dated and scoped modality tokens through masked attention with a null token. A bounded residual updates group totals and directed checkpoint allocation. A structured-state head predicts interval widths.
svg.text: 4 media roles × 2 timing classes × 7 cue types
Dated cues map to their stated forecast day.
Pooled context is optional for supported roles.
Query and mask by scope, group and day
Optional context enters only when its role has an aligned cue.
With no eligible role, the null token returns a zero residual.
Train the adapter with the arrivals-only backbone frozen.
B batch G visitor groups P checkpoints S = P + 1 scopes H forecast days D hidden width
